data.body: Fix pushed as Gerrit change 3273 (patch set 1, b5ffa1ef545ef15c53b509a0e7749e30d752eda7): converts the 11 monkeypatch.setattr(app.state, ...) sites and 3 bare app.state.config assignments to monkeypatch.setitem(<app>.state._state, ...), and adds tests/unit/test_app_state_patch_guard.py (red on the old tree, listing all 14 sites; green after). Local evidence: guard + 6 affected modules 241 passed under pytest 9.0.3 (locked) and 241 passed under pytest 9.2.0 / FastAPI 0.162.0 / Starlette 1.10.0; the two-test reproduction now passes under 9.2.0; make lint and make typecheck exit 0.
